```{r}
BRCA1_annotation <- fread("/reference/gene_models/GRCh38_gencode_v41/primary_files/gencode.v41.annotation_comprehensive.gtf") %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(V9, "BRCA1|NBR2"), V3 == "exon")%>%
  mutate(gene_name= sub('.*gene_name \"([^;]*)\".*',"\\1", V9),
         transcript_id= sub('.*transcript_id \"([^;]*)\".*',"\\1", V9),) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames = V1, start = V4, end = V5, strand = V7, type = V3, gene_name, transcript_id) %>%
  dplyr::filter(transcript_id %in% c("ENST00000357654.9", "ENST00000657841.1"))
```

### mRNA 


#### pdx

```{r}
library(edgeR)
mrna_hom_me_list <- list("134011", "134062", "SFRC01585", "WEHI_CS62", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30")

mRNA <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2025.genes.ExpectedCounts.csv") 

gene_list <- mRNA %>%
  dplyr::select( -starts_with("134"), -starts_with("S"), -starts_with("O")) %>%
  mutate(Length = `Gene End (bp)` - `Gene Start (bp)`) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Ensembl Gene ID")
mRNA_cnts <- mRNA%>%
  dplyr::select(gene_ID = `Ensembl Gene ID`, starts_with("134")|starts_with("S")|starts_with("O"), -Strand)


mRNA_cnts <- mRNA_cnts %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "gene_ID")

sample_list <- data.frame(sample = colnames(mRNA_cnts) ) %>%
  separate(sample, into = c("sample", "drop"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  dplyr::select(-drop) %>%
  mutate(sample = gsub("S1|S2", "",sample), 
         BRCA1 = if_else(sample %in% mrna_hom_me_list, "Hom", "Het"))
  

star_matrix <- DGEList(counts = mRNA_cnts, group = factor(sample_list$BRCA1), samples = sample_list, genes = gene_list)

boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)     

keep <- filterByExpr(star_matrix)
design.mat <- model.matrix(~star_matrix$samples$group)
star_matrix <- star_matrix[keep,, keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
star_matrix <- calcNormFactors(star_matrix)
boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)    

prior_count <- 2
lib_size <- star_matrix$samples$lib.size * star_matrix$samples$norm.factors
scaled_prior_count <- prior_count * lib_size / mean(lib_size)
adj_lib_size <- lib_size + 2 * scaled_prior_count

fpkm <- t((t(star_matrix$counts) + scaled_prior_count) / adj_lib_size) * 1e6 / star_matrix$genes$Length * 1e3
tpm <- t(t(fpkm) / colSums(fpkm)) * 1e6
log_tpm <- log2(tpm)


mRNA_mapping<- data.frame(sample = c( "134011_2058_T3","134048_7496_T2","134062_2233_T3" ,"134169_6606_T2", "SFRC01428S1_22235_T2", "SFRC01495S2_1537_T1", "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3" , "SOLACE20126S1_25285_T2"), alt_name = c("#11", "#48","#62" ,"#169", "#428", "#495", "#585" , "#951"),
                          meBRCA1 = c("Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1",   "Het meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1",  "Het meBRCA1"))


pdx_tpm <- data.frame(log_tpm, check.names = F) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID") %>%
  left_join(gene_list %>%
              dplyr::select(`Associated Gene Name`) %>%
              rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c("ENSG_ID", "Associated Gene Name"), names_to = "sample", values_to = "log_tpm")%>%
  left_join(mRNA_mapping)
```

```{r}
  mutate(alt_name = if_else(str_detect(sample, "BRCA1"), "UWB1+BRCA1", "UWB1"),

adj_lib_size <- lib_size + 2 * scaled_prior_count
```

##oncoprint

```{r}
`CN` =colorRamp2(breaks = c(0, 2, 3), colors = c("#4D7C93", "white", "#CC5C3E"))
HRD_score_color <- colorRamp2(breaks = c(0, 42, 100), colors = c("#AEB6E5", "white", "#A93154"))
HRD_color <- colorRamp2(breaks = c(0, 0.7, 1), colors = c("#AEB6E5", "white", "#A93154"))
meth_zygosity = c("Het"= "#481D24","Hom"= "#368F8B","No Meth" = "white")
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 50, 100),
  c("#3B6FB6", "white", "#B63B3B")   # muted blue & muted red
)
responses_col <-c( "Sensitive" = "#1B7837",  "Response" = "#5AAE61","Refractory/Resistance" = "#D73027","NA"= "#E6E6E6")


promoter_region <-readRDS("intermediate/model_methylation.RDS")

CNV <- c(Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/LUNG_bam/output/*/savana/*_segmented_absolute_copy_number.tsv"),
         Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/savana/*_segmented_absolute_copy_number.tsv"))%>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x) %>%
            dplyr::select(Chromosome = chromosome, Start_position = start, End_position =end, total_cn = copyNumber, B_cn = minorAlleleCopyNumber) %>%
            mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=/output/)[^/]+")))%>%
  mutate(total_cn = round(total_cn), B_cn = if_else(is.na(B_cn), 0, round(B_cn)),
    A_cn = total_cn - B_cn) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr =Chromosome, cn_start = Start_position , cn_end = End_position, cn =total_cn, SampleID) %>%
  filter(chr == "chr17", cn_start <= 43125532, cn_end >= 43125192) %>%
  mutate(cn = if_else(SampleID == "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53", 0, cn)) %>%
  inner_join(sample_name_mapping%>%
              dplyr::rename(SampleID = sample, Model = alt_name))

response <- sample_name_mapping%>%
  mutate(`Cisplatin Reponse` = case_when(alt_name %in% c("PDX #11", "WEHI CS62", "UWB1") ~"Sensitive",
                                         alt_name %in% c("PDX #62","PDX #169", "PDX #48", "OVCAR8", "UWB1+BRCA1") ~"Refractory/Resistance",
                                      TRUE ~ "NA"),
         `PARPi Reponse` = case_when(
           alt_name %in% c("WEHI CS62", "UWB1", "OVCAR8 A6-meth") ~"Sensitive",
           alt_name %in% c("PDX #62") ~"Response",
                                         alt_name %in% c("PDX #169", "PDX #48",  "OVCAR8", "UWB1+BRCA1") ~"Refractory/Resistance",
                                      TRUE ~ "NA"))  %>% dplyr::rename(Model =alt_name)

tmb <- fread("output/tmb.csv") %>%
  inner_join(sample_name_mapping%>%
              dplyr::rename(Model = alt_name))

HRD <- fread("output/hrdetect.tsv") %>%
  inner_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::rename(SampleID = sample, Model = alt_name))

HRD_score <- Sys.globfread("output")

mt_pdx <- promoter_region %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::rename(Sample = sample, Model = alt_name))  %>%
  filter(Gene == "BRCA1") %>%
  group_by(Gene, Model) %>%
  summarise(med_fraction_mod = median(fraction_mod))%>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels =model_order))%>%
  filter(str_detect(Model, "PDX"))  %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = med_fraction_mod) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") 
rownames(mt_pdx) <- NULL

mt_cl <- promoter_region %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::rename(Sample = sample, Model = alt_name))  %>%
  filter(Gene == "BRCA1") %>%
  group_by(Gene, Model) %>%
  summarise(med_fraction_mod = median(fraction_mod))%>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels =model_order))%>%
  filter(!str_detect(Model, "PDX"), Model!= "OVCAR8 H4-KO")  %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = med_fraction_mod) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") 
rownames(mt_cl) <- NULL




model_annotation_pdx = data.frame(Model = colnames(mt_pdx)) %>%
  mutate(model_type = if_else(str_detect(Model, "PDX #"), "PDX", "Cell line")) %>%
  left_join(CNV %>%
              dplyr::select(Model,cn)) %>%
  left_join(tmb %>%
              dplyr::select(Model,`TMB nonsilent` = TMB)) %>%
  left_join(HRD) %>%
  left_join(response) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels =model_order),
         `MeBRCA1 Zygosity` =case_when(Model %in% c("PDX #11",  "PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #62", "WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth") ~ "Hom",
                                       Model %in% c("OVCAR8 H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1")~ "No Meth",
                                       TRUE ~ "Het")) %>%
  arrange(Model) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Model") %>%
  mutate(`Cisplatin Reponse` = `Cisplatin Reponse`,
         `PARPi Reponse` =`PARPi Reponse`) 

model_annotation_cl = data.frame(Model = colnames(mt_cl)) %>%
  mutate(model_type = if_else(str_detect(Model, "PDX #"), "PDX", "Cell line")) %>%
  left_join(CNV %>%
              dplyr::select(Model,cn)) %>%
  left_join(tmb %>%
              dplyr::select(Model,`TMB nonsilent` = TMB)) %>%
  left_join(HRD) %>%
  left_join(response) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels =model_order),
         `MeBRCA1 Zygosity` =case_when(Model %in% c("PDX #11",  "PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #62", "WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth") ~ "Hom",
                                       Model %in% c("OVCAR8 H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1")~ "No Meth",
                                       TRUE ~ "Het")) %>%
  arrange(Model) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Model") %>%
  mutate(`Cisplatin Reponse` = `Cisplatin Reponse`,
         `PARPi Reponse` =`PARPi Reponse`) 


HRD_onco_plot_pdx <- Heatmap(mt_pdx, na_col = "grey", cluster_rows =F, cluster_columns = F, col = col_fun,
         top_annotation =HeatmapAnnotation(
  `TMB nonsilent` = anno_barplot(model_annotation_pdx$`TMB nonsilent`, ylim = c(0, 9)),
  # `HRDetect score` =model_annotation_pdx$hrdetect_score,
  `HRD score` = model_annotation_pdx$HRD_Score,
  `BRCA1 CN` = model_annotation_pdx$cn,
  `meBRCA1 Zygosity` = factor(model_annotation_pdx$`MeBRCA1 Zygosity`, levels = c("Hom", "Het", "No Meth")),
  `Cisplatin Reponse` = factor(model_annotation_pdx$`Cisplatin Reponse`,levels = c("Sensitive", "Response", "Refractory/Resistance", "NA")),
  `PARPi Reponse` =factor(model_annotation_pdx$`PARPi Reponse`, levels = c("Sensitive", "Response", "Refractory/Resistance", "NA")),
  annotation_name_rot = 0,
```

```{r}
library(Gviz)

report <- fread("mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2025_Study_Report.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::select(donorLabel, alignedReadGroupSet) %>%
  mutate(donorLabel = gsub("S1$|S2", "", donorLabel),
         donorLabel =if_else(donorLabel == "SOLACE20126", "SFRC01951", donorLabel),
         donorLabel =gsub("^1340|^134|SFRC01", "PDX #", donorLabel)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(donorLabel) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(track = list(AlignmentsTrack(alignedReadGroupSet, name = donorLabel))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(donorLabel = factor(donorLabel, levels = c("PDX #11",  "PDX #62", "PDX #585", "PDX #48", "PDX #169", "PDX #428", "PDX #495", "PDX #951")))%>%
  arrange(donorLabel)

BRCA1_Genemodels <- fread("../reference_GRCh38/gencode.v41.annotation_Original.gtf.gz", skip= "chr1", header  =F) %>%
  filter(V1 == "chr17", V4 >= 43044295, V5 <=43125364, 
         str_detect(V9, "MANE")) %>%
  mutate(width = abs(V5-V4+1),
         feature = str_match(V9, 'gene_type "([^"]+)";')[,2],
         gene =  str_match(V9, 'gene_id "([^"]+)";')[,2],
         exon=  str_match(V9, 'exon_id "([^"]+)";')[,2],
         exon_num = str_match(V9, 'exon_number ([^"]+);')[,2],
         transcript =  str_match(V9, 'transcript_id "([^"]+)";')[,2],
         symbol =  str_match(V9, 'gene_name "([^"]+)";')[,2],
         chromosome = gsub("chr", "", V1),
         symbol2 = paste(symbol, transcript, sep = ";")) %>%
  dplyr::select(chromosome, start = V4, end = V5, width,  strand = V7, feature, gene, exon, exon_num, transcript, symbol, symbol2) 


grtrack <-GeneRegionTrack(BRCA1_Genemodels %>%
                            filter(!is.na(exon)), genome ="hg38", name = "Gencode V41")

plotTracks(c(unlist(report[which(report$donorLabel =="PDX #585"), "track"], recursive = FALSE), grtrack),  chromosome="chr17", 
           from=43044295, 
           to =43125364 +200,
            background.title = "white", col.title = "black", col.axis = "grey", col.border.title="grey", 
           type=c("coverage","sashimi"),transcriptAnnotation = "exon_num")
```

##local methylation change
```{r}
BRCA1_5mC <- rbind(cell_line_5mc %>%
  dplyr::filter(chrom == "chr17", start >= 43125192-10000, end <= 43125532+10000),
  pdx_5mc %>%
  dplyr::filter(chrom == "chr17",  start >= 43125192-10000, end <= 43125532+10000))  %>%
  dplyr::filter(! Sample %in% c("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1","OVCAR8_LP_H4_53")) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  arrange(start)  %>%
  mutate(smoothed = stats::filter(fraction_mod/100,window_filter,sides = 2,method = "convolution"))

BRCA1_heatmap <- BRCA1_5mC %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample = sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(
    region = case_when(
      start >= 43125192 & start <= 43125532 ~ "Promoter",
      start >= 43126118 & start <= 43126443 ~ "CpG Island",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

mat <- BRCA1_heatmap %>%
  dplyr::select(alt_name, start, fraction_mod) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = start, values_from = fraction_mod) %>%
  column_to_rownames("alt_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

region_df <- BRCA1_heatmap %>%
  distinct(start, region) %>%
  arrange(start)

# Ensure order matches matrix columns
region_vector <- region_df$region
names(region_vector) <- region_df$start

# Create annotation
col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Region =factor(region_vector, levels= c("Promoter","CpG Island", "Other") ),
  border = TRUE,                     # <-- adds border
  col = list(
    Region = c(
      "Promoter" = "#FFD700",
      "CpG Island" = "#8A2BE2",
      "Other" = "white"
    )
  )
)


column_annot <-  data.frame(Model = rownames(mat)) %>%
  mutate(model_type = if_else(str_detect(Model, "PDX #"), "PDX", "Cell line")) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels =c("WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth" , "OVCAR8", "PDX #11","PDX #62",  "PDX #334", "PDX #585",  "PDX #951", "PDX #169", "PDX #495", "PDX #428", "PDX #865","PDX #48" )),
         `MeBRCA1 Zygosity` =case_when(Model %in% c("PDX #11",  "PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #62", "WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth") ~ "Hom",
                                       Model %in% c("OVCAR8 H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1")~ "No Meth",
                                       TRUE ~ "Het"))  %>%
  arrange(Model) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Model")
 
 
 


row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  ModelType = column_annot$model_type,
  `MeBRCA1 Zygosity`= column_annot$`MeBRCA1 Zygosity`,
  col = list(
    ModelType = sample_type_palette,
    `MeBRCA1 Zygosity`=meth_zygosity),
  border = TRUE,                     # <-- adds border
  gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1) 
)

heatmap <- Heatmap(
  mat[c("WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth" , "OVCAR8", "PDX #11","PDX #62",  "PDX #334", "PDX #585",  "PDX #951", "PDX #169", "PDX #495", "PDX #428", "PDX #865","PDX #48" ),],
  name = "% 5mC",
  col = colorRamp2(
    c(0, 50, 100),
    c("#3B6FB6", "white", "#B63B3B")
  ),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  top_annotation = col_anno,
  left_annotation = row_anno,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "horizontal",title = "5mC %")
)


pdf("plots/heatmap_BRCA1_ext.pdf", height = 3, width = 12)

draw(heatmap , annotation_legend_side = "bottom", heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
  Sample = c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53","UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62", "134011_1910_T4", "134062_9174_T4" ,"SFRC01428S1_22235_T2","134048_7794_T2", "SFRC01495S2_1537_T1", "SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2", "134169_6606_T2" , "SFRC01865S1_T1_2422", "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3", "SFRC01334S1_107_T5"),
  condition = c("HRP", "HRD", "HRD","HRD", "?","?", "HRD", "HRD", "HRP", "HRP", "HRP", "HRP","HRP", "HRP", "?", "?"),
 type = c("cellline","cellline","cellline","cellline","cellline","cellline","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx"  ))

HRD_HRP_meth <- rbind(cell_line_5mc %>%
  filter(Nvalid_cov >= 5,Nvalid_cov <= 100, chrom %in% paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X"))) ,
  pdx_5mc%>%
  filter(Nvalid_cov >= 5,Nvalid_cov <= 100, chrom %in% paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X"))))

cpg_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = HRD_HRP_meth$chrom,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = HRD_HRP_meth$start, end = HRD_HRP_meth$end),
  coverage = HRD_HRP_meth$Nvalid_cov,
  meth     = HRD_HRP_meth$fraction_mod,
  Sample   = HRD_HRP_meth$Sample
)

hits <- findOverlaps(bins, cpg_gr)

bin_meth <- tibble(
  bin_id = queryHits(hits),
  Sample = mcols(cpg_gr)$Sample[subjectHits(hits)],
  meth   = mcols(cpg_gr)$meth[subjectHits(hits)],
  coverage = mcols(cpg_gr)$coverage[subjectHits(hits)]
) %>%
  group_by(bin_id, Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meth = sum(meth * coverage)/sum(coverage),
    n_cpg = n(),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_cpg >= 10) %>%
  left_join(sample_info, by="Sample")

bin_meth_cellline <- bin_meth %>%
  filter(type=="cellline") %>%
  mutate(feature = case_when(
    bin_id %in% island_bins$bin_id ~ "Island",
    bin_id %in% pmd_common_binds$bin_id ~ "PMD",
    
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

bin_meth_cellline%>%
  # filter(condition != "?") %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample= sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(feature= factor(feature, levels = c("Island", "PMD", "Other"))) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=alt_name, y=mean_meth, fill=condition)) +
  geom_violin(position=position_dodge(width=0.8))+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1,
               position=position_dodge(width=0.8))+
  facet_wrap(~feature) +  # PMD / Island / Other
  labs(y="5mC (%)", x="Sample") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=hrd_palette) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8 A6-meth"),
                       c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8 H4-KO")),
    method = "wilcox.test"
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("plots/globalmethylation_cell_line_5mc.pdf", height = 6, width = 16)

bin_meth_pdx <- bin_meth %>% filter(type=="pdx")

bin_meth_pdx$feature <- case_when(
  bin_meth_pdx$bin_id %in% mcols(island_bins)$bin_id ~ "Island",
  bin_meth_pdx$bin_id %in% mcols(pmd_common_binds)$bin_id ~ "PMD",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

library(ggridges)
bin_meth_pdx %>%
  filter(condition != "?") %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample= sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(feature= factor(feature, levels = c("Island", "PMD", "Other")),
         alt_name = factor(alt_name, levels =c("PDX #11", "PDX #62", "PDX #585","PDX #428","PDX #48", "PDX #495",  "PDX #951", "PDX #169", "PDX #865", "PDX #334"))) %>%
ggplot(aes(x=mean_meth, y=alt_name, fill=condition)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.6, scale=1) +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales="free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=hrd_palette)+
  labs(y="5mC (%)", x="Sample") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14)

ggsave("plots/globalmethylation_pdx_5mc.pdf", height = 15, width = 16)
```

#Supplementary - BRCA1 ext line
```{r}
require(signal)

window_filter <- hanning(13)/sum(hanning(13))


BRCA1_5mC <- rbind(cell_line_5mc %>%
  dplyr::filter(chrom == "chr17", start >= 43125192-10000, end <= 43125532+10000),
  pdx_5mc %>%
  dplyr::filter(chrom == "chr17",  start >= 43125192-10000, end <= 43125532+10000))  %>%
  dplyr::filter(! Sample %in% c("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1","OVCAR8_LP_H4_53")) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  arrange(start)  %>%
  mutate(smoothed = stats::filter(fraction_mod/100,window_filter,sides = 2,method = "convolution"))


BRCA1_ext <- BRCA1_5mC %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample = sample)) %>%
  mutate(meBRCA1 = if_else(Sample %in% hom_me_list, "Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1"),
         meBRCA1 = factor(meBRCA1, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, group = Sample,  y = smoothed))+
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, aes(color = meBRCA1), alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_point(size = 0.4, aes(color = meBRCA1), alpha = 0.2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_palette)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 43125192 , xmax = 43125532,  ymin = -0.03, ymax = -0.02),  fill= "black", color = "black" , linewidth = 0.2)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 43126118, xmax = 43126443, ymin = -0.03, ymax = -0.02),  fill= "black", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)+
  geom_text(aes(x = (43126118 + 43126443)/2 , y = -0.06, label = "CpG Island"))+
   geom_text(aes(x = (43125192 + 43125532)/2 , y = -0.06, label = "BRCA1 Promoter"))+
  theme_bw()+
  coord_cartesian(xlim =  c(43125192-10000, 43125532+10000) )+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",strip.background = element_rect(fill  = NA))+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, name = "% 5mC")+
  xlab("Chromosomal Position (hg38)")


gg_gene_annotation<-  BRCA1_annotation %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      xstart = start,
      xend = end,
      y = gene_name
    )) +
    geom_range() +
    geom_intron(
      data = to_intron( BRCA1_annotation , "transcript_id"),
      aes(strand = strand)
    )+
    theme_bw()+
    coord_cartesian(xlim =  c(43125192-10000, 43125532+10000) )+
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),panel.border = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank())

ggarrange(BRCA1_ext, gg_gene_annotation, heights = c(0.85, 0.15), common.legend = T, legend = "bottom", nrow =2, align = "hv")

ggsave("plots/ext_brca1_smooth_5mc.pdf", height = 5.5, width = 12)
```
